Like browser and mobile use in the ChatGPT lane it is put on hold and tried later on a real device; it is claimed only with its own acceptance record.

productOwnerAuthorization.scope: The Product Owner authorized local preparation of the exact SkillPilot Coach v1.1.15 candidate for learning-unit context, scoped assessment entry and voluntary learning. Preserve all published 1.1.14 files and evidence. At preparation, all external publication and exact-candidate host acceptance remain pending. The requested release sequence is integration with successful CI, backend deployment by the Product Owner, then the personal Git Marketplace update.
excludes: Anthropic Console submission, guide activation, credential changes and inherited candidate acceptance. Deployment is handled by the Product Owner. Marketplace publication follows deployment.

releaseLine.compatibilityPolicy: The coach uses learning-unit context and the current scoped assessment choices. Learners may return to learning during an attempt and revisit individually unproven goals. The release retains the fourteen base tools, optional completion tools, OAuth, session isolation and binary mastery. Historical Connector Directory evidence and published 1.1.14 bytes are retained. Package checks bind to this candidate; service tests and approvals carry over until a change touches what they prove. Android chat is deferred (Product Owner, 28 November 2026).

stateTransitions.requires: All required plugin gates pass with approved evidence: the package checks and the public source review bound to the frozen plugin candidate digest and exact candidate revision, the service tests and approvals named with the candidate they were made with and still valid for this candidate. This includes paid Claude Web acceptance, the automated coach test through Claude's web interface and a submitter account that can submit in Anthropic's developer portal. Android chat is deferred and not claimed.
An approved submission receipt from Anthropic's developer portal (claude.ai/directory/manage, Plugin bundle) bound to the frozen plugin candidate digest and exact candidate revision.
An approved record of the actual public listing of the same frozen plugin candidate digest and exact candidate revision, with a fresh installation from that listing in paid Claude Web chat.

breakingChangePolicy: Preserve all released package bytes and evidence. The Product Owner expressly authorized the 12 September 2026 controlled-beta removal of prohibited assessment-prose inputs as correction 1.1.4 under the existing identity, with coordinated backend and catalog rollout. This narrow privacy correction is not a general compatibility exception. Other breaking plugin, identity, OAuth, state or tool-contract changes require a separately approved major-line candidate.

planStatusContractAdoption.scope: Version 1.1.7 adopts the unified backend learning-plan status. The consumed Claude connector-v1 publishes learningPlanToday.text as the only formulation together with non-numeric control fields (periodBasis, evaluable and per-subject evaluable and statusDirection; no overall statusDirection or unavailablePlanCount) and no longer publishes totals or the per-subject counts dueToday, completedToday, openToday, openOverdue and extraCompletedToday. The 1.1.7 skill quotes that text verbatim and performs no plan arithmetic. Extended on 2026-09-17 to the binding concept § 6.5: learningPlanToday.text no longer contains the active-goal announcement; the connector publishes it separately as learningPlanToday.activeGoalAnnouncement, which the skill quotes once when teaching begins.
planStatusContractAdoption.compatibilityImpact: Plugin packages up to and including 1.1.6 instruct Claude to report the removed count fields, and the production connector before this change does not publish learningPlanToday.text. Anthropic applies remote MCP changes on the next connection, so the connector change and the 1.1.7 package must reach production in one coordinated step.
excludes: Deployment, Marketplace publication, Anthropic Console submission, guide activation and inherited candidate acceptance
Connector Directory lifecycle, gates and Team/Enterprise submission access

productOwnerReleaseDecisions.scope: Remove release brakes that protect nothing for the Anthropic submission. The OpenAI review-freeze gate is gone. Package checks and the public source review stay bound to the exact candidate; service tests and approvals carry over to later candidates until a change touches what they prove. Claude Pro Android chat is deferred. The ChatGPT acceptance is no step before the Claude submission.
productOwnerReleaseDecisions.supersedes: The exclusion of inherited candidate acceptance in productOwnerAuthorization of 2026-11-19, for service tests and approvals only.
